prompt: What remains true on Saturday morning if the gardeners are still counting?
promptZh: 如果星期六上午志工還在盤點，哪一項仍然適用？

options.text: Residents can pick as many as they like once the first tie is added that morning.
options.zh: 上午一綁第一條綠帶，住戶就能不限量採摘。
options.whyZh: 上限在整項盤點結束前仍適用，跟上午何時綁第一條帶子無關。

options.text: A newly marked low branch can be used, but the household limit still applies.
options.zh: 新綁綠帶的低枝可以採摘，但每戶上限仍適用。
options.whyZh: 一紮上綠帶就已有盤點紀錄，可摘該低枝；限制要等整項盤點完成才解除。

options.text: No fruit may be picked from any newly marked branch until the new notice appears.
options.zh: 新告示張貼前，所有新綁綠帶的枝條都不能採摘。
options.whyZh: 規則依綠帶和高度判定是否可摘；不需等新告示才採摘新標記的低枝。

options.text: The two-pear limit will apply only to the newly marked branches.
options.zh: 兩顆的上限只適用於新標記的枝條。
options.whyZh: 上限依每戶摘下的總數，而非對哪根枝條單獨計算。

explanationZh: 一紮上綠帶就已有盤點紀錄，可摘該低枝；限制要等整項盤點完成才解除。
evidence: Take no more than two attached pears per household until Saturday’s count is finished. / You may pick only from low branches with a green tie. / On Saturday morning the gardeners will add green ties as they count more branches.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Take no more than two attached pears per household until Saturday’s count is finished.
You may pick only from low branches with a green tie.
On Saturday morning the gardeners will add green ties as they count more branches.

vocabulary.note: per 用來表示分配或計量的單位。
